dialogues.speaker: Rolf
dialogues.text: You'd better keep running, friend! This place is very dangerous. If the Wild Hunt shows up, I can't guarantee I'll be able to protect you!

choices.text: How do you know that the Wild Hunt will appear?

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: As a Lightkeeper, dealing with the Hunt is my sworn duty.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: See that Tideseal Stone? To ensure that the Hunt is completely and utterly eradicated, I have to stand guard here for three days and nights.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: These stones are seals placed by us Lightkeepers to dispel the permeation of the Wild Hunt.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: Although I'm not sure how it works, such suffusion will, if left unchecked, tend to draw the Hunt back to the same location.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: That's why we usually place down these stones in areas where the Wild Hunt has been pushed back. If the Hunt returns, the stones can also protect us in battle.

choices.text: I ain't scared of no Wild Hunt!

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: I'm not sure where you get your confidence, but the Hunt is not an enemy to be taken lightly.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: Let me give you a word of advice. When you come across places with these Tideseal Stones, you'd best tread carefully.

choices.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

response.speaker: Rolf
response.text: See you. Take care on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Tideseal Stone Inscription
dialogues.text: "The night sky has been devoured by deathly silence. We knead blood and bone for fuel, and so proclaim: The Long Night flows dark and deep. With these lanterns we wield, no specter shall stir from their sleep. By the lunar spirits, this pact is sealed."
